Certificate authentication is preferred. Upload one PEM containing the certificate and matching unencrypted private key; the SHA-256 fingerprint is calculated automatically. Client secrets are accepted but are less secure than certificates.

Non-secret values are pre-filled. Secrets are never displayed. Leave a secret blank to keep it, or enter a replacement. Changing authentication, mode, kind, tenant, client, origin, organization, App ID, installation ID, token identity, user identity, token kind or client certificate requires new secrets. Saving keeps SSO sign-in disabled.

Paste the PEM private key. Line breaks are preserved.

SHA-256 certificate fingerprint (64 hexadecimal characters). A combined PEM upload calculates it.

Enter the secret itself. Leave blank to keep a stored secret for the same identity.

Include one certificate and its matching unencrypted private key. The server calculates the fingerprint. Leave blank to keep the stored key and fingerprint, or use the separate fields above.

{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "tenantId",
    "clientId",
    "auth"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "tenantId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "format": "uuid"
    },
    "clientId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "format": "uuid"
    },
    "auth": {
      "enum": [
        "certificate",
        "secret"
      ],
      "title": "Authentication"
    },
    "privateKey": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "\\S",
      "x-secret": true
    },
    "thumbprintSha256": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$"
    },
    "clientSecret": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "\\S",
      "x-secret": true
    }
  },
  "oneOf": [
    {
      "properties": {
        "auth": {
          "const": "certificate"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "privateKey",
        "thumbprintSha256"
      ],
      "not": {
        "required": [
          "clientSecret"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "properties": {
        "auth": {
          "const": "secret"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "clientSecret"
      ],
      "not": {
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "required": [
              "privateKey"
            ]
          },
          {
            "required": [
              "thumbprintSha256"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ],
  "allOf": [
    {
      "if": {
        "required": [
          "auth"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "auth": {
            "const": "oauth"
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "required": [
          "clientSecret"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {
        "required": [
          "auth"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "auth": {
            "const": "client-secret"
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "required": [
          "clientSecret"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {
        "required": [
          "auth"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "auth": {
            "const": "certificate"
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "required": [
          "privateKey"
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
